text: Implemented FittedMultiblockProjection over OperatorBlockPartition and the already-fitted BlockwisePreprocessor. It assembles one global weighted frame, exposes identity-bound local schemas, unweighted projectBlock and typed weighted blockContribution results, delegates arbitrary partial projection to FeatureRestriction, and delegates explicit/least-squares synthesis to the global fitted transform. Added exact operator-partition ownership checks. Laws cover additive block contributions, score/contribution distinction, named and foreign schemas, cross-block partials, preprocessor object reuse, sparse inputs, and foreign structures. Full multivar suite passes 326/326 on JVM and 326/326 on Scala.js; diff check clean.
